composition.title: Material Composition
composition.content: Special formulation with carefully selected premium materials to deliver maximum performance and long-term durability.

application.title: Application Process
application.content: Easy application with standard dispenser. Suitable for industrial automation or manual use. No special equipment required.

storage.title: Storage
storage.content: Store at 15-25°C, away from direct sunlight. Shelf life up to 24 months when properly sealed.

certification.title: Certifications & Standards
certification.content: Certified ISO 9001:2015, SNI, and meets international standards for product quality and safety.

usageGuidelines.title: Usage Guidelines
items: Ensure surface is clean and dry before application
Do not use on wet or oily surfaces

safetyInfo.title: Safety Information
safetyInfo.description: This product is safe for industrial use. However, please follow these safety guidelines:
items: Use appropriate PPE (gloves, mask if necessary)
If contact with eyes occurs, rinse with clean water immediately
Keep out of reach of children
